summary: Frontend-only testing of /risiko.html (standalone) and /risiko.html?demo=1. HOME command-center screen renders correctly with all required data-testid buttons, hero text 'Conquista il globo a RISIKO', 'SUPABASE OFFLINE' badge, and clicking Crea/Unisciti raises the expected 'Configura SUPABASE...'/'Supabase non configurato' toasts. DEMO mode renders the full command-center layout: left column (Ordini di comando, Obiettivo segreto, Comandanti), center globe with a real <canvas> and cyan neon adjacency arcs + owner-colored dots + pulsing rings, right column (Le tue carte + trade-cards-btn, Registro operazioni). Stats strip shows Territori 42, Armate>0, Continenti 0/6. Continent legend renders. Debug helpers window.__globe, window.__TM, window.__mine() are all exposed (42 territories total, 11 owned by 'me' as Alfa). No JS console errors on any page (only harmless WebGL 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' perf warnings). Source review of tooltipHtml() confirms the hover tooltip DOM structure contains every required field: territory name, Continente + bonus, Controllo (owner + '(tu)'), Armate presenti (number), Collegamenti (count + list), continent progress (owned/total). Source review of onLabelHover confirms cursor:'pointer' on hover and renderArcs() highlights connections. onLabelClick routes to onTerritoryClick which opens #numberModal with title 'Rinforza <t>' in reinforce phase and updates via placeArmies. to-fortify-btn and end-turn-btn are rendered dynamically inside actionContent when phase changes (source verified at lines 1630-1638).
action_items: None required from a functional standpoint. All DOM-level checks passed and no console errors were observed.

TESTING LIMITATION (informational, not a bug): Playwright's synthesized mouse events (both page.mouse.move/click and element.dispatchEvent of PointerEvent/MouseEvent) do NOT trigger globe.gl's THREE.js raycaster on the WebGL canvas. As a result, the hover-tooltip appearance and click-to-open-#numberModal path could not be end-to-end automated through the globe itself. Debug marker placement confirmed that computed screen coords (getScreenCoords + container offset) land exactly on the target dot visually. The main agent already visually confirmed hover/click behavior works for real users, and the tooltipHtml() / onTerritoryClick() source code implements every requirement. If future automated coverage is desired, expose small test hooks in DEMO mode (e.g. window.__hover(id) and window.__click(id) that call onLabelHover/onLabelClick handlers directly) so Playwright can drive the raycast-guarded flows deterministically.
critical_code_review_comments: risiko.html is a very large single file (~1792 lines). Consider splitting styles, globe setup, game logic, and UI panels into separate modules for maintainability (>700 line rule).

DEMO helpers exposed on window are useful for testing but do not include the click/hover handlers or the game action functions (placeArmies, doAttackRound, endTurn). Adding thin window.__test = { hover, click, place, attack, endTurn } wrappers gated on DEMO would make the WebGL interactions automatable.
Tooltip content is complete but the '.tt-neigh' list can get very long; consider truncating with '…' after N territories to avoid overflow inside the globe.gl scene-tooltip.
No functional bugs found in the implemented flow logic based on source inspection.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all DOM-testable checks pass; globe raycast interactions not reachable via Playwright synthetic events)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Home + demo DOM/layout/console are green. The remaining tests (hover tooltip on globe, click-to-reinforce modal, attack modal + dice, fortify/end-turn flow) require raycast hits on globe.gl labels; Playwright's synthetic events do NOT trigger THREE raycasting on the WebGL canvas even when coordinates are exact (verified with an on-screen debug marker sitting exactly on a target dot). Recommend the main agent expose window.__testHooks for DEMO mode (see action_items) or verify these flows manually / via a real browser session before automating. Debug helpers already exposed: window.__globe, window.__TM (id->{lat,lng,name,cont}), window.__mine() (owned ids). Use globe.controls().autoRotate=false and pointOfView({lat:20,lng:0,altitude:1.85},0) to stabilize the view, then getScreenCoords(lat,lng,0.012) + add container.getBoundingClientRect() left/top for page-absolute coords.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional bugs. The only non-verified items are due to a Playwright + globe.gl (three.js raycasting on WebGL canvas) interop limitation: synthetic mouse/pointer events fired via Playwright's protocol do not update three.js internal pointer state used by the Raycaster. Mitigation: expose DEMO-only test hooks that call the internal onLabelHover/onLabelClick paths directly.
